title: Stock Trading Simulator
subtitle: Real-time Trading Simulation with Learning Center
description: A trading simulator with a price-time matching engine, bot traders and a live order book. You can lose money here without losing any money.
longDescription: A stock trading simulator that runs entirely in the browser. A real matching engine with price-time priority sits in the middle, supporting market and limit orders with GTC, IOC and FOK conditions, and three bots (MarketMakerBot, TrendBot, NoiseBot) trade against each other and against you every 100 ms, so the price, the order book and the candles all come out of actual trades rather than a price formula. Twelve market scenarios retune the bots, from a calm, empty market to a pump and dump; each one is tuned with seeded runs so it does what its name says, and five of them hand over to the next by themselves. The integrated Learning Center offers 19 courses across 4 categories (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Investment) with interactive quizzes and progress tracking. The Practice Center enables risk-free pattern recognition training and trading practice with rewind/replay. A rule-based analysis panel reads the live market: trend direction and strength, order book pressure, RSI-style momentum and candle patterns, each with a confidence score.
features: Real-time order matching engine with price-time priority and partial fills
Multiple order types: Market, Limit with GTC/IOC/FOK conditions
Interactive candlestick charts with multiple timeframes (15s, 1m, 5m, 30m), moving averages and volume
Bot-driven market simulation (MarketMakerBot, TrendBot, NoiseBot) on a 100 ms tick
Twelve market scenarios, from Bull and Crash to Pump & dump and Dead cat bounce; five hand over to the next by themselves
Learning Center with 19 courses across 4 categories
Practice Center for 44 chart patterns: pattern quizzes and trading practice with rewind/replay
Rule-based market analysis: trend, order book pressure, momentum and candle patterns with confidence scores
Lot-by-lot long and short positions with P&L, commission and Taiwan's transaction tax
Taiwan Stock Exchange tick rules for realistic price steps
Color theme toggle: Asian (red=up) vs Western (green=up)
Whole-lot and odd-lot modes with configurable commission, minimum fee and tax rates
challenges: Implementing accurate price-time priority matching engine

Coordinating multiple trading bots with realistic market behavior
Building comprehensive learning content with interactive elements

Making each market scenario actually behave like its name

Designed comprehensive course structure with JSON-based content management
